autobio.empty: No combined narratives yet — generate your first one above.
autobio.llm_missing_body: Autobio weaves several days into one narrative using an AI provider — connect one first.
autobio.single_day_hint: Looking for a single day instead? That's the {diary_link} tab.
autobio.subtitle: Combine several days into one cohesive narrative — generates any missing daily entries first, then weaves their text into a single story covering the whole period.
autobio.title: Autobio
cluster.hide_note: — removes it from albums and the queue. Nothing is deleted.
cluster.move_out: Move selected out to a new cluster
cluster.move_out_note: — for faces that aren't this person.
cluster.same_person_heading: Same person as any of these?
cluster.similarity_note: The number is similarity — 1.00 is identical. Anything the app was confident about is already merged, so these are the judgement calls.
cluster.unhide_note: — currently hidden from albums and the queue.
diary.combine_hint: Want to combine several days into one story instead? That's the {autobio_link} tab.
diary.empty: No diary entries yet — generate your first one above.
diary.llm_missing_body: Diary drafts your day's photos into a narrative using an AI provider — connect one first.
diary.nudge_label: Show a note on an entry when unlabeled people or places appear in it
diary.subtitle: Pick a date to draft a diary-style narrative from that day's photos — who you were with, where you went, in your own photos' words.
diary.title: Diary
download.missing_notice: The local copy of this photo's original is missing — it was saved to {path} during import, but that file isn't there anymore (moved, deleted, or imported before this backend existed).
download.oauth_missing_body: Connect a Google account first to fetch a fresh copy of this photo.
download.picker_fallback_body: As a fallback, you can re-select this exact photo in Google's own picker to fetch it one more time.
download.picking_body: Find and select the same photo in the picker below, then come back here — this page checks automatically and starts the download on its own once you're done.
download.picking_status_waiting: Waiting for you to select it…
download.picking_title: Select this photo in Google Photos
dup.body: Each of these names is on several clusters, so the same person or place is spread across more than one album. Merging is usually right — you already said they're the same.
dup.empty: Every name is on exactly one group. Nothing to merge.
dup.title: Names on more than one group
entry.delete_confirm: Delete this Diary entry? This can't be undone — you'll need to generate it again from scratch.
entry.edited_note: You've edited this entry — regenerating the whole entry won't overwrite your edit.
entry.no_photos: No photos found for this date.
entry.photos_nothing_written: {n} photos on this day — nothing written yet.
entry.photos_nothing_written_one: {n} photo on this day — nothing written yet.
entry.regenerate_segment_confirm: Regenerate just this segment from its source photos? Replaces the text above (this segment's own edit, if any, is not protected — regenerating a segment always overwrites it).
entry.regenerate_whole_confirm: Regenerate the whole entry? Any segment you've individually edited is kept — only segments that still match their original draft get replaced.
entry.tap_to_edit: tap a photo to edit it
entry.unlabeled_notice_one: {n} unlabeled person or place appears today.
error.title: That didn't work
group_detail.autobio_exclude_label: Exclude this group from Diary and Autobio
group_detail.autobio_exclude_note: Photos in this group won't appear in AI-drafted Diary entries or Autobio narratives.
group_detail.delete_confirm: Delete this group? Photos themselves are not affected.
group_detail.delete_note: — only removes the grouping, not the photos.
group_detail.no_photos: No photos in this group yet — add some from {photos_link}.
groups_page.subtitle: Occasions you've grouped by hand — not detected automatically. {browse_link} to select some and create one.
hidden.hint: Use “Not someone I know” in the labeling queue to hide strangers who happen to appear in the background of your photos.
hidden.subtitle: These are hidden from albums, the labeling queue, and merge suggestions. Nothing has been deleted — the photos and faces are all still there, they just aren't offered. Restore any of them at any time.
hidden.title: Hidden
import.already_body: This import was already finished — likely from another tab (both the picking page and the pending-import banner can reach this point for the same session). Nothing was imported twice.
import.done_google_note: This brought in photos and faces only. GPS location needs a separate Google Takeout export (the Picker API can't supply it) — run {cmd1} and {cmd2} from a terminal once you have one.
import.done_local_note: GPS location (where the photo had it) and faces both came in with this import — no separate step needed.
import.google_missing_body: Connect a Google account first to import photos from Google Photos.
import.local_body: Pick photos straight from your files — no Google account, sign-in, or browser tab juggling involved. GPS location (if the photo has it) comes along automatically, so there's no separate Takeout step either.
import.local_google_alt_link: Prefer importing from Google Photos instead?
import.pending_notice: You picked photos in Google's picker but never came back to finish — that session is still waiting to be brought in.
import.picking_body: Open the picker below and select the photos you want. This page checks automatically and will continue on its own once you're done — no need to come back and click anything, though the button below still works if you'd rather do it yourself.
import.picking_not_ready: Google says you haven't finished picking yet — still have that tab open?
import.picking_status_expired: This session expired — start a new import.
import.picking_status_waiting: Waiting for you to finish selecting…
import.start_body: Takes you to the picking page, where you'll sign in (the first time) and select which photos to bring in. Nothing is imported until you confirm you're done picking.
index.duplicate_warning: {n} names ({examples}) may be split across more than one group.
index.duplicate_warning_one: {n} name ({examples}) may be split across more than one group.
index.title: Albums
photo.draw_hint: Missed a face? Click and drag on the photo to select it.
photo.no_faces: No faces detected in this photo.
photo.no_group: Not part of any group yet — add it from {photos_link}.
photo.no_location: No location set for this photo.
photo.not_a_face_title: Not actually a face — hides it, nothing is deleted
photo.place_placeholder: Place name (e.g. a café, a landmark)
photo.title: Edit photo
queue.not_a_place_i_care_about: Not a place I care about
queue.not_sure_help: “Not sure” asks again once it grows. The last option hides it for good — undo any time under {hidden_link}.
queue.suggestions_label: Suggestions — tap to use, then edit:
queue_empty.body: Every cluster is either named or waiting to grow.
queue_empty.not_sure_note: Clusters you marked “not sure” come back once they gain {n} more photos.
queue_empty.title: Nothing left to label
queue_empty.undetected_body: These photos have no detected faces or location, so there's nothing for the queue to ask about — you can still add a place or a person by hand from each photo's own page.
same_name.body: Merging combines them into one album. Keeping them apart is fine too — do that if they're genuinely different {kind} who share a name, though renaming one is clearer in that case.
same_name.title: You have {n} groups called "{name}"
seed.confirm_body: Names are guessed from text found under each thumbnail — always check before saving. Uncheck any face that isn't a real person, or that you don't want to seed.
seed.done_body: These will be checked against new photos the next time you import.
seed.form_body: Upload a screenshot of Google Photos' "People & Pets" grid (or any screenshot with a grid of labeled face thumbnails). Faces are detected automatically and a name is guessed from the label text under each thumbnail — you'll confirm or correct every guess before anything is saved. Confirmed names are matched against new photos as they're imported, offered as a suggestion in the labeling queue (never applied automatically).
settings.anthropic_body: Powers Diary/Autobio narrative drafting. Get a key from the Anthropic Console.
settings.connect_intro: For Google Photos import and AI-drafted Diary/Autobio entries to work, this app needs its own credentials for each — this install uses your own, nothing is shared with anyone else's.
settings.google_body: Needed for "Import from Google Photos." Create a free OAuth client in Google Cloud Console (Desktop app type, Google Photos Picker API enabled), then paste the downloaded JSON file below.
settings.narrative_body: What language Diary and Autobio entries are written in — independent of the app language below, so you can read the app in one language and write your diary in another.
settings.openai_body: An alternative to Anthropic for the same narrative drafting — only one is required, not both.
settings.provider_body: Which one drafts your Diary/Autobio entries, if you've configured both above.
settings.storage_body: Where imported photos are saved on this device. Only affects new imports — photos already imported stay where they are.
settings.title: Settings
settings.ui_body: What language the app's own menus and buttons are shown in.
settings.voice_body: When labeling a person or place, you can tap the microphone next to the name field and speak instead of typing — this picks which language it listens for. Uses your browser's own speech recognition, so nothing is sent anywhere outside your normal Google/Apple/Microsoft account setup already does for that.
settings.voice_note: Not supported in every browser — Chrome and Safari (recent versions) work; if your browser doesn't support it, the mic button just won't appear and typing works as always.
summary.delete_confirm: Delete this combined narrative? This can't be undone — you'll need to generate it again from scratch.
summary.generate_hint: Generates any missing daily entries first, then combines their text (your own edits included, for any day you've already edited) into one narrative covering the whole range.
summary.nothing_yet: Nothing generated yet for this range.
summary.regenerate_confirm: Regenerate this combined narrative? Unlike a single day, a combined narrative has no separate saved-edit to protect — this will overwrite the text above, including any edit you made to it.
timeline.select_hint: Tick photos below (shift-click for a range), then name the occasion.
timeline.title: Photos by time
